# Independent tab position alias checker review

Subject: canonical clean `0aaa2c137c14e43f8cdc9d34bfd10690e63c5c70`, test/tooling-only patch `../tab-position-alias.patch` SHA-256 `8a6f755d36db437f386eeb5dc6f0077af6899d166b6827046425e2544e9e493c` (supersedes earlier `c439...`). `git apply --check` succeeds; the external overlay's two changed script contents match the patch. The owner manifest `../tab-position-manifest.json` hashes to `a40f5564534cb68f1ba5d1b7906b6934b1287dd831288ed48fd1cb1fbbf0132f`.

The patch narrowly resolves the named local export for `MatLegacyTabBodyPositionState`, requires exactly one binding to a local `MatTabBodyPositionState` type alias, and feeds the actual declared union into the existing signature comparison. It does not add an allowlist waiver or bypass a mismatch. Its local-name requirement is intentionally conservative: a future equivalent alias with a different private local name would fail until the checker is adapted; this cannot turn a changed union or alternate binding into a pass. Union order/text comparison is likewise stricter than TypeScript semantic equivalence, not a false-green relaxation.

The immutable `baseline/angular-components-16.2.x` commit is `df60e733c60e572ba538f6ad0ceff3e63e527b53`; its legacy barrel exports the type under the legacy name and its tabs source declares the five historical literals. The two cache files used by the actual-pack control hash identically to `git show` of the tag: barrel `f6a4dd305258afa9706c958c06f6260baec6258731f2fa9dba91667faa43b62c`, type file `b8cae68f00521586ecf1b69d3bce277c3e1eeba35997b05b91223b1ffcbdfaf7`. The regression derives the expected type through the tagged source graph; its positive fixture is literal sample text, not an extracted package. I independently ran the full `api-completeness-regressions.mjs` on the patched overlay with pinned Node 24.21.0; exit 0. It rejects missing export, missing local type, mutated union, wrong local binding, unexported decoy, and external alias. The separately retained actual-pack control uses the complete extracted tabs declaration and the existing difference records; I independently reran it: positive matches, and actual declaration union/binding mutations fail. The package tarball hashes to `4a34df4d024f923dd8e701b9f1ed3b63f8f23fe2dc035cc6b5a1793e0cbf9a0e`; the member bytes extracted directly from it and the control's declaration both hash to `1bfc9ca71821299ca40ecff4fe35faeabb18e2569a6d2e3d2fd13c9a9141b334`.

Independently compared the before/after retained row arrays. Open rows change 53 to 52, deleting only this historical missing-declaration row, with no added rows; recorded rows change 144 to 143, removing only the former accepted extra candidate-type row. This is a targeted checker resolution, not a declaration-wide pass or DI pass. The packed subject came from source `8a0c4866dba602bd1f9c9916128f7537d986e0b9`, not a new current-head pack. No product tests, peer floor matrix, DI or full release verification were run; evidence is bounded to these scripts, tagged oracle, controls and the stated packed declaration. Canonical source was not edited, and no push or Actions occurred.
